headlines.description: — Defenseman Lane Hutson scored 3:40 into overtime and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Dallas Stars 4-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hutson's first career OT goal gives Canadiens 4-3 win over struggling Stars

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Sidney Crosby set up Ricard Rakell's tying goal with 13.7 seconds left in regulation, then scored at 2:22 of overtime to give the Pittsburgh Penguins a 5-4 comeback victory over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crosby sets up late tying goal, scores in OT in Penguins' 5-4 victory over Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Sam Bennett and Aaron Ekblad scored unassisted goals, Daniil Tarasov made 27 saves and the Florida Panthers snapped Colorado's second 10-game winning streak of the season by topping the Avalanche 2-1 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Florida holds off Colorado 2-1, hands Avs just 3rd regulation loss of season

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Taylor Hall had a goal and an assist against his former team, rookie Brandon Bussi stopped 28 shots and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the New Jersey Devils 3-1 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hall has goal and assist as Hurricanes beat Devils 3-1 to snap 3-game losing streak

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Tyler Bertuzzi scored at 1:18 of overtime for his second hat trick of the season and fifth in the NHL to give the Chicago Blackhawks a 3-2 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyler Bertuzzi completes hat trick in OT in Blackhawks' 3-2 victory over Golden Knights
